name: The Unwritten Ascent
act: Act III: The Unwritten Road & The Grey Chasm
description: Act III staging ground: The high scree trail where the road unloads into raw wireframe void over a 6-meter chasm. Requires geodetic triangulation and Orom's literal wish-stone to cross.

cast.name: Orom the Literal Smith
cast.description: Demands exact material, dimensions, and load capacity before striking a bridge slab; punishes vague prompts literally.

cast.name: Surveyor Vellum
cast.description: Locks local coordinates with her brass theodolite so the unwritten road does not dissolve into fog.

primitives.name: Cryo-Entropy Beacon Monolith
primitives.stage_role: Environmental Hazard: Radiates -273°C entropy aura along the ridge
primitives.description: Tapered obsidian obelisk with pyramidion apex projecting absolute zero cold, spiked into the mountain bedrock.

primitives.name: Orom's Granite Bridge Slab
primitives.stage_role: Chasm Crossing: Spans the 6-meter unwritten void when properly specified
primitives.description: Spanned across the 6-meter chasm to bridge the void where the road unloads into unwritten grey mist.

primitives.name: Geodetic Triangulation Cairn
primitives.stage_role: Reality Anchor: Certifies the northern pass into warranted terrain
primitives.description: Marker cairn stabilizing local coordinate mesh with a certified brass theodolite and surveyor's slate tally.
